news.title: MullaeCompany launches its first product, onl:on Liposomal Iron
news.body:
MullaeCompany’s first product, onl:on Liposomal Iron, launched on August 13, 2026.
Designed by a pharmacist mother, onl:on Liposomal Iron balances taste, absorption, and function.
Each daily stick contains 12 mg of Taste+ liposomal iron without the characteristic metallic taste of iron, plus vitamins C, B6, and B12 and active folate.
Its refreshing berry flavor makes it easy to take without water. It is designed for the whole family—from growing children to women who need extra iron.
Available now at onlon.kr and the onlon Naver Smart Store.
